minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  February 08, 2021

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting  ID:
960 5053 9618 Passcode: 017243 at 11:43 am.

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office

  Staff Present:  Thomas Bunn, Video and Social Media

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of February 01, 2021, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Megan Brennan – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing animation and
  visual FX services to the City in the amount of $3,000.00. Motion carried unanimously.

3. Michael Towns – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing audio mixings
  and recording services to the City’s Video and Social Media department in the amount of $500.00.
  Motion carried unanimously.

4. Eduardo Olmos – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing audio and video
  recording services to the City’s Video and Social Media department in the amount of $500.00.
  Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 11:58 a.m. Adjournment
